name: oklch-prism-architect
description: Generador de paletas OKLCH con exportación de tokens y vista previa UI, modernizado con Bun + Vite+.

scripts.check: bun run scripts/run-with-log.mjs check vp check
scripts.check:fix: bun run scripts/run-with-log.mjs check-fix vp check --fix
scripts.lint: bun run scripts/run-with-log.mjs lint vp lint
scripts.fmt: bun run scripts/run-with-log.mjs fmt vp fmt
scripts.test: bun run scripts/run-with-log.mjs test vp test --run --coverage --reporter=verbose
scripts.build: bun run scripts/run-with-log.mjs build vp build
